purpose: Orchestrator-run verification of the build work in the worktree.
instructions: Pass means: tests and static checks pass in the worktree. For a ticketed unit: the red run was recorded before implementation (step log line), the landed test files are unchanged since the red commit (test-integrity), the ticket's declared test passes, and the full suite passes. Repository writes stay inside the worktree. worktree.md records branch and path. No VCS operation was run by the worker.
restrictions: MUST NOT modify the repository, the worktree, or any deliverable.
